heme_involvement_pattern.primary_compartment: extramedullary (soft tissue mass composed of myeloid blasts)

biomarkers.name: MPO, CD34, CD117, lysozyme, CD68
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable panel; MPO is often positive but may be weak/negative in monoblastic cases; CD34 and CD117 are variable; lysozyme and CD68 are often positive in monocytic/myelomonocytic differentiation
biomarkers.clinical_use: Confirms myeloid lineage; often monocytic differentiation

biomarkers.name: Same molecular workup as AML (cytogenetics, FLT3, NPM1, IDH, etc.)
biomarkers.prevalence: As per AML; recurrent abnormalities reported in myeloid sarcoma include RUNX1::RUNX1T1 [t(8;21)], CBFB::MYH11 [inv(16)/t(16;16)], KMT2A rearrangements, NPM1 mutations, and FLT3 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Uses the same diagnostic and risk/predictive molecular assessment as AML; t(8;21) is a recognized association with myeloid sarcoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Extramedullary tumour mass composed of myeloid blasts (often monoblastic/myelomonocytic differentiation); infiltrative growth in soft tissue
variants: chloroma (green colour from myeloperoxidase visible on fresh cut section)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Treated as AML regardless of morphology

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Extramedullary infiltration by immature myeloid cells; often perivascular or diffuse

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: AML cells (same as underlying AML) with tropism for extramedullary sites
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Same as underlying AML — often monoblastic/myelomonocytic differentiation; myeloperoxidase content can give characteristic green colour on fresh cut section ('chloroma')
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Extramedullary tropism — some AML clones develop capacity for tissue infiltration; homing molecule expression (including CXCR4 and adhesion molecules) may reflect distinct clonal properties
